Enquiry.title: Enquiry
Enquiry.description: Admission enquiry from prospective students and parents.

studentName.description: Full name of the prospective student.

parentName.description: Full name of the parent or guardian.

currentClass.description: Current grade or class of the student.

admissionClass.description: Target grade or class requested for admission.

enquiryType.description: Category or area of inquiry interest.

previousSchool.description: The student's previous school, if any.

preferredContactMethod.description: Preferred communication method, e.g., WhatsApp or Call.

message.description: Optional message or remarks from parent.

consent.description: Consent check state to be contacted.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the enquiry, e.g., 'New'.

enquiries/{enquiryId}.description: A collection of admission enquiries received online.
